text.tspan: CV SEND 4 (drives both ganged VC pins)
Gain law (all 7 sends): 0 V = -82.8 dB (mute, still passes signal), 2.0475 V = +10.1 dB,
45.4 dB/V = 0.022 dB per DAC code (MCP4728, 2.048 V internal ref, gain x1). 0 dB at 1.825 V.
Temperature compensation: pad 42.2k || NTC 47k B4050 per scaler; drift < 0.05 dB above -40 dB, < 0.08 dB above -60 dB, 10-45 C.
Place each NTC against its SSI2164: TH1-TH4 at U1, TH5-TH7 at U2.
CV filter: 2-pole MFB, -3 dB at 300 Hz, Q 0.63 (no overshoot). VC pins driven directly
(10k inputs; any series resistance would scale the law).
Send 4: U2 ch3+ch4 ganged per datasheet Fig. 7 (one Rin/RC, outputs and VC tied): -3 dB noise.
Polarity: inverting buffer + inverting VCA stage = sends in phase with AUDIO_IN.
Outputs drive the AUX buses through 10k summing resistors (as the MIX bus): the master needs one virtual-earth amp
per bus (10k feedback = unity per channel). DC offsets add on the bus: AC-couple or servo the bus amps.
MODE open = Class AB (-96 dBu noise per channel at 20k). Fit R(M) 22k for Class A.
Drives 7 VCA inputs in parallel (about 2.5k total).
INPUT BUFFER (inverting: VCA stage inverts again)
POWER / MODE / DECOUPLING (100n at every supply pin)
